summary: Metadata preservation is now generally available, enabling transfers to retain POSIX attributes and symlinks across POSIX filesystems and object ACLs, CMEK, temporary holds, and object creation time when moving objects between Cloud Storage buckets; Storage Transfer Service now supports preserving metadata during data transfers.
extended_definition: Metadata preservation is now generally available, enabling transfers to retain POSIX attributes and symlinks across POSIX filesystems and object ACLs, CMEK, temporary holds, and object creation time when moving objects between Cloud Storage buckets; Storage Transfer Service now supports preserving metadata during data transfers.
